thread:
Alex: Weekly release train check-in: v3.7 traffic rebalance for inference + embeddings happening now. Heads-up on a short pause window if needed.
Maya: Canary went live 09:00 UTC. Noticed a p95 bump on embeddings-infer (~+4050ms) at ~09:12.
Sahil: Looking into it  seeing GPU-side queuing on canary hosts gpu-4..gpu-7. Applying rollback of quant-plugin on canary.
Sahil: Command run:
```
kubectl -n canary rollout undo deployment/quant-plugin --to-revision=12
```
deploy-bot: [09:18 UTC] Canary deploy v3.7.2 -> rollout-status: 3/3 pods ready. No crashloops. (ci: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/789)
Maya: After rollback p95 fell back to baseline in ~3m. Live dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/ingress/embeddings — monitoring red clusters.
Lisa: Due to the transient impact, instituting a temporary release freeze for the train: 10:00-12:00 UTC. Hold non-critical deploys and any config that moves traffic. Submit exemption requests to #eng-releases with a short test plan.
Alex: Ops plan: well watch for 1h, then resume a staged rollout with lower concurrency and longer ramp. Key goal: avoid client retry amplification.
Maya: Changelog notes added: "quant-plugin rollback on canary", "traffic rebalance for embeddings-infer", "temporary release freeze 10:00-12:00 UTC". PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/eng/release-notes/456
Sahil: Running a 60m heat test now; will update with final metrics. If anything spikes, we abort resume and extend freeze.
Alex: Thanks all. Post any anomalies here. :thumbsup:
